strips.why: flicker: patches change and change straight back on 29% of the shot's frames (2 cells here)

summary: The strip is mostly clean: a steady push-in down the table with no visible pops or large flicker, though the "one man" isn't readable and the turkeys sit stiff.

faults.what: The idea is one man alone at the end of the table. No figure is readable at the far end, only a tiny pink throne speck. The foreground candelabra and the turkeys on both sides take the focus, so the 'alone' feeling is weak.
faults.fix: Make the figure at the far end readable, or push the camera in until he clearly reads. Reduce the foreground turkey and candelabra clutter.

faults.what: The turkeys lining both sides sit in near-identical rigid poses. They look like copies and show no idle motion across the frames.
faults.fix: Vary the turkeys' head turns and idle timing, or add small head bobs on a few.
